evidence: Carries the Mempool label and deletes age-based transaction expiry and the entry_time multi-index container from CTxMemPool.
rationale: Eliminating age-based expiry prevents dropping transactions that could still be mined and reduces mempool overhead by removing an entire multi-index container. The author notes that age eviction 'is incentive-incompatible: it may drop transactions that could still be mined' and that removing the index drops per-entry dynamic memory usage from three indexes to two.
